name: Aodhán
text: Aodhán is the modern Irish form of the old name that MacKillop writes as Aedan. The word rests on the root of fire and is a young form of the name Aodh. English texts often render the name as Aidan.

attributes.attribute: modern Irish form of the name of a child, Aidan

okr.objective: Record the modern Irish form Aodhan.
key_results: Link it to the older name.
